description: This file defines Express route handlers for authentication-related endpoints, including user registration, login, retrieving current user info, and logout. It also provides a diagnostic echo endpoint.

methods.name: GET /auth/echo
methods.description: Diagnostic endpoint to test connectivity and CORS, returning the origin, timestamp, and request path.

methods.name: POST /auth/register
methods.description: Registers a new user, with validation and activity logging, and returns an auth token and user info.

methods.name: POST /auth/login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, logs activity, and returns an auth token and user info.

methods.name: GET /auth/me
methods.description: Returns current user info extracted from the authorization token.

methods.name: POST /auth/logout
methods.description: Logs out a user (statelessly), recording activity.
